SessionStart.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .claude/crashlytics-context.md ]; then echo "Crashlytics context available at .claude/crashlytics-context.md"; else echo "No crashlytics context found"; fi'
SessionStart.description: Check for Crashlytics crash data injected by external tooling

SessionStart.command: bash -c 'ENCODED=$(pwd | sed "s|[./]|-|g"); MEM="$HOME/.claude-personal/projects/${ENCODED}/memory/MEMORY.md"; if [ -f "$MEM" ]; then echo "=== Active memory index ==="; cat "$MEM"; echo; fi'
SessionStart.description: Display Claude Code's auto-memory index at session start — keeps standing preferences (tight mode, honest pushback, etc.) front-of-context without re-deriving each session

SessionStart.command: bash -c 'STAMP=.claude/.last-memory-audit; if [ ! -f "$STAMP" ]; then echo "⚠ Memory audit never run — run /audit-memory"; else LAST=$(cat "$STAMP" 2>/dev/null); LAST_TS=$(date -j -f "%Y-%m-%d" "$LAST" +%s 2>/dev/null || date -d "$LAST" +%s 2>/dev/null); NOW=$(date +%s); if [ -n "$LAST_TS" ]; then DAYS=$(( (NOW - LAST_TS) / 86400 )); if [ "$DAYS" -gt 30 ]; then echo "⚠ Memory audit overdue ($DAYS days since last) — run /audit-memory"; fi; fi; fi'
SessionStart.description: Remind to run /audit-memory if >30 days since last audit (or never)

PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'echo "Reminder: commit after every logical change with [STORY-ID] format"'

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit"; then echo "Commit made — update board-context.md if task status changed"; fi'
PostToolUse.description: Remind agents to update board context after commits
